CAS — 58957-92-9 (idarubicin); 57852-57-0 (idarubicin hydrochloride). ATC — L01DB06. ATC Vet — QL01DB06. (idarubicin) Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn and US. USP 31 (Idarubicin Hydrochloride). A red-orange to red-brown powder. Slightly soluble in water; insoluble in acetone and in sol- vent ether; soluble in methyl alcohol. A 0.5% solution in water has a pH between 5.0 and 6.5. Store in airtight containers. Incompatibility. Licensed product information states that pre- cipitation occurs when idarubicin hydrochloride is mixed with heparin, and that it will degrade in alkaline solution. Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precau- tions As for Doxorubicin, p.712. Raised liver enzymes and bilirubin can occur with idarubicin. Severe enterocoli- tis with perforation has been reported rarely. A cumu- lative total dose limit has not yet been defined. UK li- censed product information states that total cumulative oral doses up to 400 mg/m2 have a low probability of cardiotoxicity, and no significant cardiotoxicity was seen in patients treated with mean cumulative intrave- nous doses of 93 mg/m2.
